title: Contraction c on C_d(Φ, V)[φ_x]
body_html:
Contraction on $C_d(\Phi, V)[\phi_x]$

Let $e_x : C_\bullet(\BSigma) \otimes V \to (C_\bullet(\BSigma) \otimes V)[\phi_x]$ be the projector to the $\phi_x$-isotypic component, $$e_x(\mathcal{F} \otimes v) \;=\; \int_{g \in K_{x,+}} \phi_x^{-1}(g)\, g\mathcal{F} \otimes gv.$$

Lemma. For each vertex $x \in A$, the contraction $c$ on $C_\bullet(\BSigma)$ from [[node:building.contraction_extension_K3]] induces a map $$c : C_d(\Phi, V)[\phi_x] \to C_{d+1}(\Phi, V)[\phi_x].$$
proof_html:
By [[node:coefficient_systems.support_in_BSx]], the relevant chains are supported in $\BSigma_x$, where $c$ is defined and $K_{x,+}$-equivariant. For $\mathcal{F} \otimes v \in C_d(\BSigma_x) \otimes V$, $$c(e_x(\mathcal{F} \otimes v)) = \int_{g \in K_{x,+}} \phi_x^{-1}(g)\, c(g\mathcal{F}) \otimes gv = \sum_\mathcal{E} c(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E})\, e_x(\mathcal{E} \otimes v),$$ using $c(g\mathcal{F}) = g \cdot c(\mathcal{F})$ for $g \in K_{x,+} \subseteq \Fix_G(x)$.

For each $\mathcal{E}$ with $c(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E}) \ne 0$, property (C2) gives $z \in \mathcal{E}$ on a geodesic from $x$, and axiom (T5) gives $K_{\mathcal{E},+} = (K_{x,+} \cap K_{\mathcal{E},+}) (K_{\mathcal{F},+} \cap K_{\mathcal{E},+})$. Choose coset representatives $\{g_1, \dots, g_n\} \subseteq K_{x,+} \cap K_{\mathcal{E},+}$ so that $K_{\mathcal{E},+} = \bigcup_i g_i (K_{\mathcal{F},+} \cap K_{\mathcal{E},+})$. A direct calculation shows $e_x(\mathcal{E} \otimes v) = e_x(\mathcal{E} \otimes e_\mathcal{E}(v))$, landing in the $\phi_x$-isotypic component. (Use (T4) for the agreement $\phi_x(h) = \phi_y(h)$ on $K_{x,+} \cap K_{y,+}$.) $\square$
